Name: Vanilla-Style Cain and Nightcat
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I like my characters to all be done in a vanilla style so I've been utilizing Poltergeister & Jazzybee's [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdv-creator-masc]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url] to give some custom NPCs a makeover! I decided to share the ones that have open permissions or I've been given permission for in case you're OCD like me.

This is a portrait replacement for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28170]New NPC Cain and Nightcat 1.6[/url]﻿ by muxuelaiyin, originally by RoseTeenager (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18090). I received a request for this one and was granted permission by RoseTeenager, Cain's original author, to make these portraits. Just download, drag and drop over the original mod, and let it overwrite! *Note: These portraits do NOT need portraiture like the original ones do. The manifest has been edited for this.

Enjoy!

~Like my work? [url=https://ko-fi.com/silvermoonchan]Buy me a coffee![/url] ☕
